The '''Great Northern Forest''' was a large [[Forest/Legends|forest]] on [[Myrkr/Legends|Myrkr]] inhabited by [[vornskr]]s and [[Ysalamiri/Legends|ysalamiri]]. It was also the site of [[Talon Karrde]]'s [[Myrkr Base|base of operations]]. [[Hyllyard City]] was located near the forest.

==History==
[[File:SW_TTT_-_HTTE_5.jpg|thumb|left|180px|A [[Vornskr]] attacks [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] in the forest.]]

During [[Thrawn campaign]], [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] was captured by [[Talon Karrde]] and his [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]]. He was sent to Karrde's base on Myrkr but eventually escaped the base in a [[GAT-12 Skipray Blastboat|Skipray Blastboat]]. He was pursued by [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] in the Great Northern Forest. After the crash of their Skipray, the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] was captured by Mara Jade. They latter tried to go out the forest but both were captured by [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn's]] forces. They were conducted to [[Hyllyard City]] where they were [[Rescue on Myrkr|rescued]] by [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] and Karrde's smugglers.
